_comment: Single source of truth for the insurers displayed as Adler & Rochefort partners across the site (partner logo strips, homepage hero-trust lines, brand-chip rows, and any quote-form or meta-description copy that enumerates them). Do not add or remove a name here without the same approval this list itself required. This file does NOT govern editorial articles about a named insurer (e.g. /en/blog/medis-health-insurance-portugal/) — those stay untouched even for a name that is no longer a partner.
